input: Simulate the voltage across a capacitor while an RC circuit charges from a battery.
recognizedText: Simulate the voltage across a capacitor while an RC circuit charges from a battery.
explanation: The RC circuit consists of a resistor (R) and a capacitor (C) connected in series to a DC battery (voltage source V). When the circuit is completed the capacitor charges according to V_C(t)=V\,(1- e^{-t/(R C)}). We assume ideal linear components, no internal resistance of the battery, and an initial capacitor voltage of 0 V. The visual simulation will display the capacitor voltage versus time as it approaches the battery voltage.
